facts: Theranos received a CLIA Waiver from the FDA for its herpes simplex 1 virus IgG (HSV-1) test and test system on July 16, 2015.
The FDA cleared the Theranos HSV-1 test and test system on July 2, 2015.
The CLIA waiver permits the use of the HSV-1 test in locations outside of traditional clinical laboratories, including Theranos Wellness Centers.
Theranos provided study data from 818 subjects of varying age and ethnicity demonstrating accurate system performance using finger sticks and venous draws.
Theranos Wellness Centers are located in Arizona, Palo Alto in California, and Harrisburg in Pennsylvania.
Theranos was founded in 2003 by Elizabeth Holmes.
